scenes.title: It starts with an idea.
lines: What if one idea could set an entire engineering workflow in motion?

clips.text: What if one idea could set an entire engineering workflow in motion?

scenes.title: Define your goal.
lines: Tell AI Engineer what you want to design.
Define the capacity, site, and constraints. Then start the conversation.

clips.text: Tell AI Engineer what you want to design.
Define the capacity, site, and constraints. Then start the conversation.

scenes.title: Give ideas shape.
lines: Reference geometry, design domains, meshes, and loads come together.
Code and three-dimensional previews stay connected. Step in and refine the design at any time.

clips.text: Reference geometry, design domains, meshes, and loads come together.

scenes.title: Make material matter.
lines: BESO and CalculiX optimize the topology. Reconstruction and S Q P sizing then refine the geometry and member dimensions.
The language model proposes actions. Deterministic solvers return the evidence.

clips.text: BESO and CalculiX optimize the topology. Reconstruction and S Q P sizing then refine the geometry and member dimensions.

scenes.title: Let physics answer.
lines: Zwind performs the final coupled-response check of the selected design.
Against TuQiang, surge and mooring tension decrease. Pitch and tower-top acceleration increase, within the evaluated limits.

clips.text: Zwind performs the final coupled-response check of the selected design.

scenes.title: Turn feedback into progress.
lines: When meshing or solving fails, diagnose the cause, adjust the plan, and verify again.

clips.text: When meshing or solving fails, diagnose the cause, adjust the plan, and verify again.

scenes.title: Clear criteria. Traceable decisions.
lines: Internal screening requires an overall score of eighty-five, with each dimension at sixty or above.
Across ten commissioned projects, nine meet the agreement rule between two scoring channels. This is not a probability of certification.

clips.text: Internal screening requires an overall score of eighty-five, with each dimension at sixty or above.

scenes.title: Lighter. More economical.
lines: For the twenty-megawatt case, steel intensity falls from two hundred seventy-eight to two hundred forty-seven point nine tonnes per megawatt, down ten point eight percent.
Under a steel-proportional assumption, estimated unit cost is seventeen thousand six hundred fifty-six yuan per kilowatt.

scenes.title: From evidence to external appraisal.
lines: The selected design scored ninety-one, grade A. Models, drawings and calculation reports form its technical dossier.
After three clarification rounds, it received C C S Approval in Principle: independent appraisal at the concept level.
